title: Dataset for Identification of Homophobia and Transophobia in Multilingual YouTube Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of an expert-annotated dataset of multilingual YouTube comments (English, Tamil, and Tamil-English code-mixed) and evaluation of various machine learning and deep learning text classification models to identify and categorize homophobic derogation and threatening language.

Creation of an expert-annotated dataset of multilingual YouTube comments (English, Tamil, and Tamil-English code-mixed) and evaluation of various machine learning and deep learning text classification models to identify and categorize transphobic derogation and threatening language.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
